style_when: scale is the story — a port, a refinery, a data centre hall, a rail yard, a skyline of cranes — and the reader needs to feel how big it is
prompt: 200mm telephoto compression inside a gas engine power hall on a plant floor; three modular gas engine generators receding in a row, the nearest unit just beyond a painted safety-yellow threshold line on polished concrete; hard directional light from the right rakes across brushed steel and cast iron, deep charcoal shadows, graphite and steel blue with safety-yellow accent; crisp industrial air, fine film grain; asymmetrical framing with hero unit off-centre left, threshold line cutting diagonally; no people, no text, no logos.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, watermarks, logos
rationale: This is a systemic, operational story about regulatory thresholds and plant scale, not a single purchasable object. Long telephoto compression conveys the scale of the gas plant while making the threshold line a hard physical boundary across the floor. It avoids the sterile datacenter or abstract regulatory trope and grounds the invisible 6.6/8.5/19.9 MW lines in a real industrial environment.
subject: Modular gas engine generators lined inside a power hall, with the nearest unit just beyond a painted yellow threshold line on polished concrete.
core_thesis: Going behind the meter changes a site's regulatory identity rather than its supply: a gas plant crosses mandatory greenhouse-gas reporting at 6.6 MW running flat, the Title V major-source line at 8.5 MW, and PSD for carbon at 19.9 MW.
core_conflict: Backup gas generation versus regulatory major-source status, where operational thresholds silently convert a standby asset into a heavily permitted power station.
composition: Extreme asymmetry with repetitive generator modules receding into compressed telephoto distance, threshold line slicing diagonally across frame

review.reason: The frame shows exactly the article's object — modular gas engine generator units behind a painted yellow threshold line — which literalizes the permit-threshold mechanism the headline and lead describe.
